record.question: In case the medical record is misfiled, then the following steps should be followed:
record.explanation: Answer D: All of the above. Checking adjacent folders, using the numbering system to search for likely misfiles, and checking known digit transpositions are all reasonable tracing steps. Source/context note: The “3 in 5 and 8” mnemonic is not a universal filing rule; answer reflects the apparent combined troubleshooting list. Reference: https://iris.who.int/bitstream/handle/10665/208125/9290610050_rev_eng.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
